title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Supply Chain Manager

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in Centennial, CO looking to add a Supply Chain Manager to their team. The role is a Direct Hire position.

Responsibilities :

• Support Development/Performance
o Evaluate and drive manufacturing supplier performance including quality, delivery, cost, etc.
o Engage in problem solving.
o Analyze supply chain processes to identify areas for improvement i.e. removing bottlenecks
o Identify trends and generate reports to inform decision-making
• Supplier technical development
o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) Design of manufacturing changes and cost savings - alternative suppliers to assure
production delivery schedules
o Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, distributors, and other stakeholders.
o Locate and qualify new suppliers while maintaining the highest quality and lowest cost.
o Analyzing data to identify bottlenecks, track performance, and generate reports for
stakeholders.
• Manufacturing/Engineering Projects
o Monitor inventory and communicate results with stakeholders.
o Develop inventory strategy to deliver the right parts at the right time and in the right quantity.
o Provide recommendations for materials selection
o Obtain material quotes for manufacture per engineering specifications.
• Develop and implement strategies to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall supply
chain performance.
• Provide support to the supply chain to develop and qualify new and existing suppliers.
• Develop and support new supplier qualification plans.
• Communicate with new and existing suppliers to address quality issues and implement corrective
actions.
• Develop supplier performance KPIs and provide feedback on results.
• Provide manufacturing support for project management/engineering programs
• Participate in Manufacturing and Engineering drawing review activities as needed, communicate with suppliers as required.
• Participate in supplier development and Manufacturing planning meetings as needed.
Work closely with the Engineering and Manufacturing teams to resolve supplier quality issues.

Qualifications :

• Ability to review and understand detailed engineering drawings
• Knowledge of quality control systems
• 10+ years working with vendors
• 10+ years' experience in manufacturing and quality
• Trade School Certificate or Bachelors in related field
o Engineering degree (preferred)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Attention to detail
• Strong Leadership Skills
• Balanced decision making
• Knowledge of supply chain management principles
• Strategic thinker
• Proficient in ERP systems
• Preference will be given to candidates with knowledge/experience with turbine, oil/gas and/or power generation
